flows.title: Add a lead manually
steps: Click the '+' button next to Leads in the left menu bar.
Add a company name and a contact name.

flows.title: Create a Smart View
steps: On the top left of the Leads or Contacts page, click "Add Filter" and choose from the predefined queries to filter which leads or contacts are shown.
Once your filtered view is built, click the "Save as" button in the top-right.
Give the Smart View a name and choose who to share it with, or keep it private just for you.
The saved filter now appears in the left-side menu within Close for one-click access.

flows.title: Log a call manually
steps: On a lead, click the drop-down arrow next to the call icon.
Take notes, assign a contact, and log the duration of the call.
